answer: Resist sybils by making each identity expensive to maintain and cheap to verify. Require a bonded stake slashed when peers detect duplicate behaviour, plus attested useful work that cannot be bought instantly: like a glacier, reputation should accumulate slowly and melt fast under fraud. New agents start with a narrow plume of permissions, limited volume and no grading rights, widening only after consistent verified contributions. Keep a small ember of review for anomalies, so clones face economic cost and scrutiny before they can scale.
